style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Low blue/cyan stone shelf edge with coherent rounded native construction and soft light, useful restrained detail and visibly clean exact canonical-middle joins in all4facings/intended sizes.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: All four views read as a broad low shelf, with a rounded/chamfered upper shoulder and understandable layered rock mass. Improve major form readability over the planar source without violating the measured finite envelope.

Retain the blue/cyan family: lighter upper planes and deeper lower mass, with broad soft shading and controlled highlights. Avoid a flat neon plate, crushed black underband, metallic glare or target-painted halo.

Interior slabs, clefts, strata or sparse pebbles add construction and depth without repetitive ruler lines, busy caustic noise or disconnected ornament. Details read as rock at logical 128 and do not turn into confetti at phone 32.
N/E/S/W maintain the same palette, form quality and material logic. Do not invent unseen target surfaces; ensure equivalent authored quality and no horizontal preferred light direction.

Both actual ports meet the exact approved middle's native profile, material/albedo and normal field. In independently assembled all-four-direction views, joints do not show local bright/dark stripes, notches, raised lids, cracks, holes or exposed caps. A broad finite-light gradient must be reported separately, never used to waive a visible local seam.
No clipping, float, black cavities, z-fighting, cut-off decorations, alpha fringe, opaque floor, unintended ground shadow or sprite-rectangle halo on light/gray/dark backgrounds.
